clay.summary: Optimize representations for reader success/safety/context cost, not compactness alone.

frank.summary: Keep deterministic authority semantics; verify projection integrity; counterbalance GWT order/winner metadata; hold ClayGraph activation out of hot path.

gwt.summary: Separates transport from reconstruction/uptake and adds direct proxy evidence for order/winner confounds.

emergenz.summary: No emergence mechanism directly tested; representation/order confounds are methodological controls for future small-model emergence tests.

claycode.summary: Zero-shot compact/readable projections are not reliable enough; compact safety semantics produced unsafe accepts.

hyperposition.summary: Reader projection favors explicit relation-instance role labels while canonical n-ary semantics remain valid.

claygraph.summary: Current activation implementation remains HOLD due major latency/context overhead despite some relational retrieval benefit.
